# B07 — Custom Design Systems (Draft Dev Scope)

**Status:** **DRAFT — not ready for detailed task assignment.**  
**Outcome:** User có thể tạo, preview, lưu, cập nhật, xóa Custom Design System từ built-in/Deck theme, và dùng system đó cho Deck mới mà không làm thay đổi Deck cũ.  
**Specs:** UC-010, FR-096–099, FR-106, FR-112, FR-135; BR-003/017/018, FR-022/092/093.  
**Depends on:** B04's finalized theme-role and template contracts; B02 model/protocol; B03 brand asset ingestion.  
**Decisions:** [ADR-0007](../adr/0007-design-system-templates.md), [Architecture](../architecture/design-system-templates.md).

## 1. Confirmed scope

- **Design System** has complete named theme values, rules in words, logo/font asset refs. **Template** has built-in layouts per format, and user cannot save a custom Template. Do not introduce Style Presets as a separate domain.
- User may start from a built-in, another Custom Design System, current Deck theme or default. Custom copy doesn't mutate its source; every required theme role remains populated.
- Before save: show values/rules/assets and a sample slide; surface conflicting rules and unsupported rules, don't silently decide contradictory pairs (FR-096).
- Save/update/remove Custom Design System must not change existing Deck theme. Only a later explicit request can change a Deck's effective theme (FR-106).
- Keep custom data in Application Storage; built-ins shipped with repo and immutable. Use B04 theme translator/template contracts, **not** a second token system.

## 2. Ownership (preassigned, implementation details later)

| Owner | Future responsibility |
|---|---|
| `packages/presentation/design/` | Catalog, immutable built-in definitions, custom persisted revisions, validation + theme-copy rules |
| `packages/presentation/deck/` | Keep Deck theme snapshot; explicit theme change only via approved Deck operation |
| `packages/host/api/` | Custom Design System create/update/remove/preview APIs with validated inputs |
| `apps/local-web/` + `packages/client/runtime/` | Create/edit/preview UI, show conflicts/assets, confirm save |
| `apps/local-web/src/opencode/` | Scoped model interpretation of brand rules, not a second design database |

## 3. Preconditions before converting Draft → Detailed

1. B04 sets **BR-003 V-1**, **BR-017 V-1**, **BR-018 V-1/V-2** in product spec, with working default HTML theme and template.
2. Theme role schema, custom copy behavior and default source are concrete. Preview can read B04's actual renderer without creating new renderer logic.
3. Brand logo/font validation, storage format and safe handling are implemented or scoped from B03 contracts.
4. UC-010 flows are mapped into small tasks, with source evidence of current code and no unresolved product contradiction.

## 4. Developer checks planned (not a tester plan)

- Unit: full theme copy, role validation, built-in immutability, name uniqueness, conflicts/unsupported rule handling.
- Integration: custom from built-in → Preview → Save → select in generation → restart → same values; edit/delete custom → existing Deck snapshot unchanged; logo/font assets remain resolvable.
- Security: custom brand text cannot become extra tool permission; all assets remain within managed storage; no write to registered project folder.

**Draft boundary:** Do not invent a default Design System, token-role list, built-in template catalog or custom DS storage schema before B04 settles product values. Dev can investigate UI/reuse independently, but should not report B07 implementation ready.
